title: Figure 2: Critical cooling rate charts for metallic glass formation
description: Two charts captioned "Figure 2. Critical Cooling Rate." Panel (a) is a temperature-time transformation schematic showing liquid, supercooled liquid, crystal and glass regions, with cooling paths 1-3 between melting and glass transition temperatures. Panel (b) plots critical cooling rate (K/s, log scale) against reduced glass transition temperature, contrasting pure nickel, "Conventional" metallic glasses (thickness < 1 mm) and bulk metallic glasses (> 1 mm), with labeled alloys such as Pd-Cu-Ni-P and Zr-Ti-Cu-Ni-Be.
